map.🔋 冷启动为何电流大: 🔋 Why Cranking Current Is Higher When Cold
map.冷态机油黏度高、机械阻力大，起动机需输出更大扭矩，电流随之升高、效率下降，属正常: Cold oil is viscous and mechanical drag is high, so the starter must deliver more torque; current rises and efficiency falls. This is normal.
map.电瓶内阻随老化上升，启动瞬间端电压跌落更明显。以内阻与冷启动电流（CCA）评估健: Battery internal resistance rises with age, so terminal voltage sags more during cranking. Internal resistance and cold cranking amps (CCA) judge battery health more reliably than voltage alone.

map.启动瞬间电压为什么掉很多？: Why does voltage drop so much while cranking?
map.起动机是超大电流负载（百余安），电池内阻与线缆压降在瞬间拉低端电压，属于正常；但: The starter is an enormous current draw (over a hundred amps), so battery internal resistance and cable drop pull terminal voltage down momentarily; that is normal. But if it falls below 9V and the engine still will not turn, suspect a discharged battery, corroded terminals or a binding starter and check the supply path.
map.起动机效率一般多少？: What efficiency is normal for a starter?
map.直流起动机典型效率约 60%–75%，其余化为铜损与铁损发热。冷启动电流大、效率: A typical DC starter runs about 60%–75%, the rest turning into copper and iron losses as heat. High cold-cranking current with lower efficiency is normal; sustained readings below 50% with abnormal heating usually mean mechanical binding or electrical aging.
